title: Basra — Museum, Old City & Shatt Al Arab
full_text:
After breakfast, head to the Basra Museum — once one of the old presidential palaces in Basra.
Having a walk in old Basra with Shanasheel houses, Ashar Canal and the Old Basra Bazaar.
River tour in Shatt Al Arab by Ashari boats and a walk along the Corniche of Basra.
